svg.aria-label: Who does what in Resolve. Deterministic rules: Match a request to a fictional policy and prepare a fixed-template response. Status: In the demo. AI assistance: An optional Claude screen can add routing to a person. It cannot clear a rules stop, approve an outcome, or change data access. Status: Optional, early signal. Human review: A reviewer approves or rejects the pending recommendation. Status: Simulated review. Autonomous action: None. No employment action or specialist notification is executed. Status: Not permitted.
